summary: Operator's 2026-27 rate page confirms $60/night for 2 incl. electric and Wi-Fi; added 30/50-amp full hookups, laundry, Wi-Fi, reservations by phone with a $300 deposit. Note trimmed of rates and rating; 55-plus and no-dogs caveats added. Not stated: site count, rig length, season, showers.
flags: Criteria (long-stay rule): the operator says 'We are a 55 plus park. Sorry we do not allow dogs.' (sevenspringsrvpark.com/rates/), sells 180-day seasons and 3-month packages on signed leases and stores park models. It does rent by the day and week ($60 / $360), so nights are for sale, but a 55+ age limit fails a passing family traveller - a human should decide.

Price gate: $60/night base for 2 is over US$50, but the park is ~37 km from the Tampa gateway (audit/price_research/gateways.py), so the gateway exception applies. The family has not stayed here (no trip references).
